intro: Choose where each Square item appears. Preview the exact cards before saving.
workflow: 1. Choose a place → 2. Check the cards → 3. Save
new_help: New Square items and new variations stay unpublished until you review them here. Use Stock for counts and labels; use Site catalog for website placement.
help: How to keep the catalog tidy
help1: Same product, different size or fabric? Add a variation to the existing product and keep one card.
help2: Different models stored under one Square item? Choose separate cards and name each model clearly.
help3: Workshops belong in Workshop, repair services in Repair. Deposits, shipping and register-only charges should stay Square only.
square_help: Website placement and website titles do not change Square names, SKUs, prices or stock. Names and prices from Square are shown in their original language.
global_off: Website publication is off. Your saved placements will appear when you enable “Show my stock on my site” in Overview.
demo: Sample data only. Nothing is saved to Square or the live website.
preview_help: Sold-out tracked variations are omitted. “Not tracked” does not confirm physical availability.
review_help: This item stays off the website until a destination and variations are confirmed.
hidden_help: Available in Square and the register; hidden on the website.
no_live_variations: No cards will appear. Select an available variation, or check its stock.
layout_help: Use one card for sizes or fabrics of the same product. Use separate cards for different models.
variant_help: A new variation is saved in Square first. Return here to include it on the website.
confirm: I checked the destination, included choices and website preview.
select_variation: Select at least one variation to publish.
save_error: Could not save. Your changes are still here. Check your connection and try again.
load_error: The catalog could not load. Use Refresh to try again.
create_help: Saved in Square with its price and stock. The destination below controls its website placement.
variant_context: Adding a choice to this existing Square product
after_add: Item saved. Open Site catalog to check its placement.
partial: Saved in Square, but a follow-up step failed. Do not add it again. Refresh and check photos, stock and website placement.
not_connected: Connect Square from Overview to organize your website catalog.
no_price_input: Enter a price. For variable-price services, keep the existing Square record and choose its destination in Site catalog.
help_title: Start here. Your shop, one place.
help_intro: Use these shortcuts to find the right screen. The guide stays here whenever you need it.
help_orders_text: Open a work order, check the drawing and contact details, add notes, save its status, then print the saved ticket.
help_catalog_text: Choose Shop, Workshop, Repair or Square only. Preview grouped or separate cards and confirm the included variations before saving.
help_stock_text: Use Stock to update counts or add an item. For another size of the same item, choose Add variation. Use Label to prepare a barcode label.
help_editor_text: Choose a named section, select text or a photo, review before and after, then send the change for review. Stock photos are managed from Stock.
help_phone_text: On iPhone, open this panel in Safari, use Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android, use Chrome → Install / Add to Home screen. Then enable this device’s notifications in the panel. Email delivery will be connected at Rufcut handover.
help_faq1: An item is missing from the website
help_faq1_text: Check its destination and included variations in Site catalog, check stock, and make sure website publication is on in Overview. New items need review.
help_faq2_text: Open Site catalog. For sizes or fabrics of one product, select One card. Different models may need separate cards and clearer website titles.
help_faq3_text: Read the message beside the affected area. Check your connection and retry. A work order is sent only when a ticket number appears. If an item was saved in Square but a later step failed, refresh and edit that item instead of adding it again.
help_skip: I know my way around. Open my panel directly next time on this device.
help_continue: Save preference and open my panel
help_return: You can always reopen this page with Need help?
track_inventory: Track physical stock in Square (turn off for services)
